questions.q: Explain how belief in the Last Day can change how a pupil treats others.
questions.a: Knowing every deed will be judged (99:7-8), a pupil is fair and kind, even when no one sees.

questions.q: Extend: why are small regular deeds loved by Allah?
questions.a: They are sincere and lasting, and they shape character.

questions.q: Stretch: can someone have iman but weak actions? What do scholars say?
questions.a: Iman includes actions; sins weaken iman but do not remove it unless they are disbelief.
